story.title: Your intellectual fly is open when you use an LLM to author a post (2025)

draft:
Your intellectual fly is wide open whenever you hand the pen to an LLM.

I just read the Hacker News discussion on a 2025 essay that argues the convenience of AI‑generated copy comes with a hidden cost: we stop catching our own blind spots. The model will happily fill gaps, but it also mirrors the biases and gaps in the data it was trained on—often surfacing ideas we never meant to endorse.

I’ve started treating LLM output like a first draft, not a finished product. I ask myself: What assumptions am I overlooking? Which phrases feel like they’re borrowing someone else’s voice? By forcing a manual pass, I’m not just polishing grammar; I’m re‑asserting my own critical lens.

How do you keep your personal insight sharp when you lean on AI for content creation?

#LLM #AIWriting #TechEthics #ContentCreation #Productivity
